# Bootstrap Checklist

1. Choose the new post slug.
2. Create `rawdocs/<slug>/` with `raw/`, `memory/`, and `outputs/`.
3. Create `00-meta.yaml` and `log.md`.
4. Create the required memory files from the repo conventions.
5. Add an initial log entry documenting scaffold creation.
6. Set the target Hugo post path in `00-meta.yaml`.

Prefer reusing the existing `rawdocs/bpmn-workflow-fsm/` structure as the baseline example.
